title: We had great time!
text: I was celebrating my birthday with my friends and we had a lot of fun! Carlos and Hugo were very nice and helpful, not even wavy sea stopped us from enjoying it! Definitely to repeat. Also I booked directly on WhatsApp and my messages were replied quickly and very helpful.

title: Our journey
text: We have had a wonderful trip! Thank you very much Alvaro for being very kind. I totally recommend it and hope we see you again!
author: bensuo2020

title: Fantastic experience!
text:
We booked a private boat for a business outing with colleagues and clients, and everything was perfect, with great attention to detail. Our skipper, Albert, was incredibly friendly and knowledgeable, sharing valuable insights throughout the trip. The boat was well-equipped, with plenty of snacks and drinks for everyone to enjoy. It was a fantastic experience that combined business and leisure seamlessly
I highly recommend it!
author: 647silvioh

title: Fantastic!
text: Albert and Anje were fantastic. We did a 3 hour private trip whilst on honeymoon and would highly recommend! Albert was our skipper, he took us out to see the Barcelona coastline and we were lucky enough to see the Americas Cup up close. We then swam and went into the Barcelona harbour to marvel at the architecture and super yachts. The cava, beer and snacks were delicious. My husband and I agree that this was the best day of the 4 we spent in Barcelona. Thank you Albert and Anje!
author: Hannah_S

title: Great experience
text:
We booked the 4 hours and loved it, there were drinks for everyone and a cheeseboard and also we could carry anything we wanted and the patron was very friendly.
The boat ride was very cool, we could bathe and it was very good, I recommend it 100%

title: Good atmosphere and treatment of older people
text: Yesterday we had a wonderful sailing experience with the family. The attention provided at all times was delicate and friendly taking into account that there were elderly people. Good atmosphere. Highly Recommended.
